description:
Rooney Auctioneers are delighted to present No. 3 St James Court to the market.
No. 3 St James Court presents an excellent opportunity to acquire a spacious and highly versatile five-bedroom residence in a quiet and established setting just off the Ennis Road, one of Limerick’s most sought-after residential locations.

Situated in an exclusive leafy cul-de-sac of just seven homes, the property enjoys a particularly private setting together with a desirable south-facing aspect. To the front, the residence overlooks a mature, tree-lined green area and benefits from a spacious driveway, with potential for gated access, complemented by a mature evergreen Griselinia hedge.
The property offers generous and well-proportioned accommodation throughout, with bright reception rooms and excellent flexibility for modern family living. A significant additional feature is the large attic space, extending to approximately 41 sq. m. The attic is partially floored and benefits from electricity, offering excellent potential for conversion to additional accommodation, subject to the necessary planning permissions and building requirements.
Another particularly attractive feature is the self-contained apartment located to the side of the property. This versatile space offers a range of potential uses, including a home office, consulting or medical rooms, business accommodation, additional living space for family members or, subject to the relevant requirements, a separate rental opportunity.

The apartment could potentially generate rental income of approximately €14,000 per annum. Subject to meeting the relevant Revenue requirements, rental income of up to €14,000 per annum may qualify for Rent-a-Room Relief. Purchasers should satisfy themselves as to their individual eligibility and tax position.
No. 3 St James Court may also qualify for the Vacant Property Refurbishment Grant, which currently provides funding of up to €50,000 towards the refurbishment of a qualifying vacant property. Purchasers should satisfy themselves as to the property’s eligibility and refer to the official Government guidelines for the most up-to-date information.

Externally, the property benefits from private gardens with a landscaped patio and pond, creating a peaceful outdoor setting and an excellent space for entertaining and relaxing.
The location is a major attraction. Positioned just off the Ennis Road, the property is within easy reach of a wide selection of shops, supermarkets, cafés, schools, sporting facilities and everyday amenities. Local shopping options include Lidl, Dunnes Stores and Tesco Superstore, while Limerick City Centre and the wider road network are also conveniently accessible.
For sports enthusiasts, the property is particularly well positioned for access to Thomond Park and TUS Gaelic Grounds, both within the wider Ennis Road area.
With its exclusive cul-de-sac setting, south-facing aspect, generous five-bedroom accommodation, self-contained apartment, substantial attic space and excellent potential for further enhancement, No. 3 St James Court represents an exciting opportunity to acquire and create a substantial family home in a highly convenient and well-established Limerick location.
